name: shri-health-contracts
description: Shri Health API contract tooling: bundle, lint, lint fixtures, mock server, breaking-change check.

scripts.bundle: REDOCLY_TELEMETRY=off REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true redocly bundle openapi/shri-health.yaml --output openapi/dist/shri-health.bundled.yaml
scripts.check:bundle-fresh: npm run bundle && git diff --exit-code -- openapi/dist/
scripts.validate: REDOCLY_TELEMETRY=off REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true redocly lint openapi/dist/shri-health.bundled.yaml --config openapi/redocly.yaml
scripts.lint: npm run bundle && npm run check:layout && npm run validate && spectral lint openapi/dist/shri-health.bundled.yaml --ruleset openapi/.spectral.yaml --fail-severity error
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run lint:fixtures && npm run test:yaml && npm run links
